title: The Long Light of Barley Common
description: Tailwind sprint through the barley: pulsing gusts, polished ice lanes with stone braking bays and awn brambles. Read the gust, commit, brake on stone. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

identity.scope: Monthly sample route; not a final five-minute day

rooms.name: The hot tailwind
rooms.lesson: The wind gusts and dies · vault the awn beds, brake on the stacks. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: Polished threshing boards
rooms.lesson: Carry speed across the polished ice · stop on stone. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: Between the harvest walls
rooms.lesson: Gusting walls of barley · vault low between the awns. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The granary walk
rooms.lesson: Climb onto the granary roofs above the heat. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The long hot straight
rooms.lesson: Commit to the cuts between gusts, then brake on the wide stacks. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The evening headwind
rooms.lesson: The last run pushes back in waves. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.
